The 2034 Formula 1 Grand Prix is set to electrify the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to experience it than from the deck of a private yacht. Our fleet of 16 boats departs from Puerto Banús, minutes from the action. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40, with all taxes, skipper, and fuel included. This guide covers everything you need to know to secure your vessel and make the most of race weekend.

Why Choose a Boat Rental for the F1 Grand Prix?

Watching the F1 from a boat offers unmatched flexibility. You can cruise between viewpoints, drop anchor near Cabopino or Cala del Faro, and avoid the packed grandstands. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, so you can focus on the race and the scenery. With drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava) and light snacks provided, it's a turnkey experience. The Mediterranean in late May or early June delivers 25–30°C temperatures and calm seas – perfect for a day on the water.

  • Estepona area – quieter, with fewer boats, ideal for a relaxed experience.

Your skipper will know the best spots on the day, depending on wind and race timings.

Every rental includes: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and IVA. No hidden fees. You just bring yourselves and sunscreen. For the Mangusta 80, a jet ski is included free of charge – perfect for buzzing around between race sessions.

Tips for a Perfect F1 Boat Day

  • Arrive 15 minutes early at Puerto Banús – parking can be busy.
  • Bring a tablet or phone with a live stream of the race (our boats have USB ports).
  • Pack a hat, sunglasses, and a light jacket – sea breezes can be cool.
  • Consider a half-day (4h) or full-day (8h) charter to enjoy the full experience.
  • Book a sunset charter after the race for a memorable end to the day.
